mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of the instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the previous 2 months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator for economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of the instances where HOUST increases by more than 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5% signals a restrictive monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of the instances where FEDFUNDS is above 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% each over the previous 2 months signals robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and INDPRO increase > 1% each in 2 months
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of the instances where both RSAFS and INDPRO increase by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 over the previous month signals a weakening labor market, which is a leading indicator for economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of the instances where PAYEMS decreases by more than 100,000.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over the previous 3 months signals increased supply-side capacity, which is a positive indicator for economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of the instances where INDPRO increases by more than 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained real GDP growth (GDPC1) above 2% annualized over the previous 6 months signals strong economic demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of the instances where GDPC1 growth is above 2% annualized.
